se_candidates_prior_only.label: Gravity net-flux (baseline A)
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \sum_{j \ne i} (T_{ji} - T_{ij}),\quad T_{ij} = \kappa\, p_{i,t}^{\alpha} p_{j,t}^{\beta} \, d_{ij}^{-\gamma}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i equals the sum over j of inflow minus outflow, with T_ij = κ * p_i^α * p_j^β / d_ij^γ.

definitions.T_ij: Pairwise flow from i to j
definitions.K(d_ij): Not used explicitly (power-law distance enters directly as d_ij^(-γ))

assumptions_added_by_you: Complete graph with T_ii = 0
Add a small epsilon to d_ij if needed to avoid division by zero at zero distance

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Single-constrained gravity (baseline B)
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \sum_{j \ne i} (T_{ji} - T_{ij}),\quad T_{ij} = p_{i,t}\, \frac{p_{j,t} \, K(d_{ij})}{\sum_{k \ne i} p_{k,t} \, K(d_{ik})},\quad K(d_{ij}) = d_{ij}^{-\eta}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is net inflow minus outflow with row-normalized destination choice: T_ij = p_i * [p_j K(d_ij) / Σ_k p_k K(d_ik)], K(d)=d^-η.

definitions.w_ij: Row-normalized destination probability p_j K(d_ij)/Σ_k p_k K(d_ik)
definitions.T_ij: Row-constrained flow from i to j

assumptions_added_by_you: Complete graph with T_ii = 0
Add a small epsilon to denominators for numerical stability

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Rank-choice net flux (Zipf-weighted)
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \sum_{j \ne i} (T_{ji} - T_{ij}),\; T_{ij} = p_{i,t} \, \frac{p_{j,t} \, f_r(i,j)}{\sum_{k \ne i} p_{k,t} \, f_r(i,k)},\; f_r(i,j) = \frac{\lambda S}{r_i(j)} + 1 - \lambda
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is net flux with row-normalized choice using rank-based weights f_r(i,j) = (λ S)/r_i(j) + 1 − λ, where r_i(j) is j's rank by distance from i.

definitions.r_i(j): Rank of j by increasing distance from i (1 = nearest)
definitions.f_r(i,j): Rank-frequency weight per E6 with memory parameter λ
definitions.T_ij: Flow from i to j under rank-weighted destination choice

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Uses Zipf/rank-weighted choice rather than power-law distance in the numerator; structurally distinct from gravity.
assumptions_added_by_you: Break ties in ranks arbitrarily but consistently
Exclude i=j from ranking; f_r(i,i)=0

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Symmetric Zipf-rank Laplacian
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} W_{ij}\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; W_{ij} = \rho_{ij}^{-\sigma},\; \rho_{ij} = \min\{r_i(j), r_j(i)\}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian with pair weight W_ij = [min of mutual ranks]^-σ, where ranks are by increasing distance.

definitions.r_i(j): Rank of j by distance from i
definitions.W_ij: Symmetric rank-based weight using ρ_ij = min{r_i(j), r_j(i)}

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A symmetric consensus/Laplacian operator based on mutual rank, not a gravity flow or row-constrained choice.
assumptions_added_by_you: Mutual rank defined via min of directional ranks to ensure symmetry
Exclude self-loops and handle rank ties consistently

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Betweenness-modulated power-law Laplacian
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} W_{ij}\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; W_{ij} = (b_i b_j)^{1/2} \, d_{ij}^{-\eta}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian with weights scaled by the geometric mean of node betweenness centralities and power-law distance decay.

definitions.b_i: Node betweenness centrality computed on the distance-weighted complete graph (edge weights = d_ij)
definitions.W_ij: Symmetric pair weight sqrt(b_i b_j) * d_ij^(-η)

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Consensus-like diffusion scaled by centrality, not origin–destination gravity flows.
assumptions_added_by_you: Compute betweenness using shortest paths with edge cost = d_ij
Normalize b_i to [0,1] if needed to aid identifiability

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Edge-betweenness weighted Laplacian
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} W_{ij}\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; W_{ij} = e_{ij}^{\delta} \, d_{ij}^{-\eta}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian where pair weights are boosted by edge betweenness centrality to emphasize structural corridors, with power-law distance decay.

definitions.e_ij: Edge betweenness centrality for the (i,j) edge on the distance-weighted complete graph

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Diffusive exchange weighted by edge betweenness, not OD gravity flows.
assumptions_added_by_you: Compute edge betweenness with edge cost = d_ij and treat the graph as undirected
Rescale e_ij to avoid extreme weight disparities (e.g., divide by mean or max)

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Cluster-constrained coupling
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} W_{ij}\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; W_{ij} = [\rho_{\text{in}} \mathbf{1}_{c(i)=c(j)} + \rho_{\text{out}} \mathbf{1}_{c(i)\ne c(j)}] \, d_{ij}^{-\eta}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a Laplacian with stronger within-cluster and weaker between-cluster coupling, both decaying by distance.

definitions.c(i): Cluster label of node i obtained from distance-based spatial clustering

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Consensus-like within/between-cluster exchange rather than OD gravity; uses community geography.
assumptions_added_by_you: Derive clusters from D using a spatial clustering method (e.g., k-means on embedded coordinates or hierarchical clustering on distances)
Set K_clusters based on model selection or prior knowledge

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Span-adaptive kernel Laplacian
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} \left(\frac{d_{ij}}{s_{ij}}\right)^{-\eta} (p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; s_{ij} = \sqrt{s_i s_j},\; s_i = \frac{1}{k} \sum_{j \in N_k(i)} d_{ij}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a Laplacian with distances normalized by local span s_i (mean distance to k nearest neighbors), making coupling scale-aware.

definitions.N(i): k-nearest neighbors of i by distance
definitions.s_i: Local geographic span of i (mean distance to N_k(i))
definitions.s_ij: Geometric mean of local spans for i and j to ensure symmetry

parameters.name: k
parameters.meaning: number of nearest neighbors for local span

parameters.name: η
parameters.meaning: decay exponent applied to normalized distance

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Scale-adaptive consensus using local geographic span rather than OD flows.
assumptions_added_by_you: Use k-NN to define N_k(i)
Exclude self-distances and add epsilon if s_i is very small

se_candidates_prior_only.label: Nonlocal power-law interaction (fractional-style)
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a nonlocal Laplacian-like operator with power-law coupling over all distances.
se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A symmetric, mass-exchange operator with no OD flow formulation; purely kernel-driven consensus.
assumptions_added_by_you: Set d_ii to infinity or exclude j=i to avoid self-coupling

se_candidates_prior_only.label: kNN-limited power-law Laplacian
se_candidates_prior_only.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} W_{ij}\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; W_{ij} = \frac{\mathbb{1}_{j \in N_k(i)} + \mathbb{1}_{i \in N_k(j)}}{2} \, d_{ij}^{-\eta}
se_candidates_prior_only.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian restricted to k-nearest-neighbor pairs (mutualized) with power-law distance weights.

definitions.N(i): k-nearest neighbors of i by distance

se_candidates_prior_only.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A sparse, neighborhood-limited consensus operator rather than global OD gravity flows.
assumptions_added_by_you: Use mutualized kNN (average of directional indicators) to keep W_ij symmetric
Choose k informed by observed community scales

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Explore–return mixture net flux (memory-modulated)
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_latex: SE_i = \sum_{j \ne i} (T_{ji} - T_{ij}),\; T_{ij} = p_{i,t}\,\Big[(1-P_{new})\,w^{\text{return}}_{ij} + P_{new}\,w^{\text{explore}}_{ij}\Big],\; P_{new} = \frac{1}{1+\lambda(\ln S + C)}
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is net flux where each origin splits between returning to local neighbors and exploring globally; the mixture weight P_new follows the memory-driven exploration formula.

definitions.N(i): k-nearest neighbors for the return set
definitions.w^return_ij: Row-normalized weights on N(i) (e.g., proportional to 1/d_ij) and 0 outside
definitions.w^explore_ij: Row-normalized weights over all j using K(d_ij)

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Combines memory-driven exploration probability with local/global kernels, not a pure gravity choice.
assumptions_added_by_you: Use 1/d_ij for return weights and d_ij^-η_e for exploration weights
Set w^return_ij and w^explore_ij to zero for i=j

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Dual-layer overlap mixture Laplacian
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian mixing a local geometric layer and a quasi-communication layer, weighted by overlap Γ.

definitions.K_ℓ(d_ij): Local kernel with strong decay, e.g., d_ij^(-η_ℓ)

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A two-layer mixture operator governed by overlap Γ, not OD gravity exchange.
assumptions_added_by_you: Approximate the communication layer by a shallow-decay kernel since no explicit comm network is available
Normalize K_ℓ and K_c (e.g., to unit row sums) if needed for identifiability

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Two-scale piecewise power-law Laplacian (regime shift)
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} K(d_{ij})\,(p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; K(d) = \begin{cases} a\, d^{-\eta_1}, & d < r_0 \\ b\, d^{-\eta_2}, & d \ge r_0 \end{cases},\; b = a\, r_0^{\eta_2-\eta_1}
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian with a break in distance-decay at scale r0, capturing a regime change in coupling.

definitions.K(d_ij): Piecewise power-law with continuity at r0
definitions.r0: distance scale where coupling regime changes

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A nonlocal consensus operator with a two-regime kernel rather than OD-based transfer.
assumptions_added_by_you: Choose r0 to match inferred scale where behavior changes
Continuity enforced via b = a r0^(η2−η1)

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Span- and cluster-aware Laplacian
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian using distance normalized by local spans and with within/between-cluster weighting.

definitions.s_i: Local span (mean distance to k nearest neighbors)
definitions.s_ij: Geometric mean of s_i and s_j
definitions.c(i): Cluster label from distance-based spatial clustering

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Combines span normalization and community geography in a symmetric exchange operator, not OD flows.
assumptions_added_by_you: Define clusters from distance-only data
Use mutualized kNN to compute s_i robustly in sparse regions

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Corridor-enhanced diffusion (edge betweenness boost)
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is a symmetric Laplacian with an additive boost proportional to edge betweenness, emphasizing high-traffic corridors.

definitions.ȳe (\\bar e): Mean edge betweenness across all pairs

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: Uses centrality-derived corridor boosts within a consensus operator, not OD gravity.
assumptions_added_by_you: Compute e_ij on the undirected distance-weighted complete graph
Clip or rescale e_ij/\bar e to avoid extreme weights

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Column-stochastic inflow kernel
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \Big[\sum_{j \ne i} v_{ji} \, p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}\Big],\; v_{ji} = \frac{K(d_{ij})}{\sum_{m \ne j} K(d_{mj})},\; K(d) = d^{-\eta}
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is inflow from all sources j to i via column-normalized distance kernel, minus the state at i.

definitions.v_ji: Column-normalized weight from source j to destination i

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A column-normalized inflow operator (consensus toward a kernel average), not an OD gravity net flux.
assumptions_added_by_you: Exclude self loops in normalization sums
Add small epsilon to denominators for stability

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.label: Rank-truncated + tail choice (net flux)
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_latex: SE_i = \sum_{j \ne i} (T_{ji} - T_{ij}),\; T_{ij} = p_{i,t}\, \frac{p_{j,t} \, w_{ij}}{\sum_{k \ne i} p_{k,t} \, w_{ik}},\; w_{ij} = \begin{cases} \frac{\lambda S}{r_i(j)} + 1 - \lambda, & r_i(j) \le R \\ c\, d_{ij}^{-\eta}, & r_i(j) > R \end{cases}
se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_plain: SE_i is net flux with a rank-based Zipf weight for the top-R nearest destinations and a distance-based tail beyond R.

definitions.r_i(j): Rank of j by distance from i
definitions.w_ij: Hybrid weight: rank-based for top R ranks; power-law for the tail

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.difference_from_gravity_baselines: A hybrid rank–distance choice rather than single power-law gravity.
assumptions_added_by_you: Break ties in ranks consistently
Set c to ensure smooth transition at the cutoff R (optional continuity constraint)

se_candidates_context_plus_creativity.se_latex: SE_i = \kappa \sum_{j \ne i} \big[a\,\mathbb{1}_{\{j \in N_k(i) \lor i \in N_k(j)\}} + b\,\mathbb{1}_{\{\text{otherwise}\}}\big] \, d_{ij}^{-\eta} (p_{j,t} - p_{i,t}),\; 0 \le b \le a
